app.title: Voxbound
app.subtitle: Meeting notes with Open WebUI
privacy.local.description: Recordings and meeting history are saved in Chrome. Transcription sends audio to your configured Open WebUI server.
capture.description: Record the current tab. You can optionally capture your microphone as a separate source.
record.microphone.description: Records your microphone separately from the tab audio.
process.description.empty: Start a recording, then transcribe and summarize it through Open WebUI.
process.description.ready: The recording is ready for transcription and summary generation.
process.empty.title: No meeting content yet
process.empty.state: Transcripts and summaries will appear here after a recording is processed.
workflow.label: Meeting workflow
workspace.description.review: Review the transcript before generating the summary.
workspace.description.done: Your summary is ready to copy or export.
transcript.saved.later.summary: The transcript is saved locally. You can summarize it later from History or move straight into the next recording.
new.recording.ready: Ready for a new recording. Start recording when the next meeting begins.
recording.ready.to.transcribe: The recording is saved locally as a draft. Transcribe it, or discard it if the recording was accidental.
restored.last.draft: The most recent meeting draft has been restored.
restored.audio.draft: A saved recording has been restored and is ready to transcribe.
recorder.reset: The recording has been reset. The saved audio draft was removed.
recording.captured: Recording saved. You can close this popup and return later to transcribe it.
recording.captured.keep: Recording captured. Keep this popup open until transcription has started.
meeting.saved: Meeting saved locally in Chrome storage.
meeting.saved.synced: Meeting saved locally and synced to Open WebUI Knowledge.
meeting.saved.sync.warning: Meeting saved locally, but Open WebUI sync failed.
no.summary.to.copy: There is no summary to copy yet.
settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Connect the extension to an Open WebUI instance.
settings.setup.incomplete: To use the complete workflow, enter the exact summary model ID exposed by Open WebUI, then save and check the connection.
settings.privacy.title: How your meeting data moves
settings.privacy.description: Recording starts only when you request it and meeting data stays in the Chrome profile. Audio goes to Open WebUI; forwarding depends on the STT provider configured there.
backend.description: Open WebUI receives audio and routes transcription and summaries to the models configured there.
openwebui.base.url.invalid: Enter a valid Open WebUI URL starting with http:// or https://.
openwebui.base.url.https.required: Remote Open WebUI instances require HTTPS. Unencrypted HTTP is allowed only for localhost.
openwebui.host.permission.denied: Access to {origin} was not granted. The extension cannot reach this Open WebUI instance without that permission.
api.key.placeholder: Leave blank if your local instance does not require authentication
summarization.model.help: Exact model ID exposed by Open WebUI. Select the STT model separately in Open WebUI → Admin Panel → Settings → Audio.
endpoint.paths.description: Keep the defaults unless your Open WebUI installation exposes different routes.
stt.endpoint.help: This path does not select a model. Configure the STT provider and model in Open WebUI Admin Panel → Settings → Audio.
summary.behavior.description: Control how the transcript is converted into structured meeting notes.
summary.prompt.help: These instructions guide style and priorities. The fixed note structure is protected automatically.
recording.settings.description: Choose language and live transcript behavior for future recordings.
live.transcript.setting.description: Optional: sends audio snippets to Open WebUI during recording. Leave it off with slower STT providers.
settings.actions.description: Save changes locally, then test the endpoint before your next confidential recording.
knowledge.sync.description: Also store meetings as searchable documents in Open WebUI so they can be queried there through RAG.
knowledge.sync.enabled.description: Saves transcripts and summaries into an Open WebUI knowledge base and updates them when the meeting changes later.
knowledge.sync.name: Knowledge base name
knowledge.sync.name.help: The extension creates this knowledge base automatically when needed and stores one Markdown document per meeting inside it.
knowledge.sync.complete: Meeting synced to Open WebUI Knowledge.
knowledge.sync.disabled.detail: Knowledge sync is disabled in the extension settings.
meeting.history.title: Meeting History
meeting.history.description: Your meetings stay stored locally in this Chrome profile.
search.placeholder: Search by title, model, transcript, or summary
no.meetings.search.help: Try a different title, model, transcript phrase, or summary term.
no.meetings.empty.help: Recorded and saved meetings will appear here after your first transcription.
missing.meeting.id: This meeting could not be opened because the meeting ID is missing.
meeting.not.found: This meeting could not be found. It may have been deleted or saved in another Chrome profile.
loading.meeting.description: Opening the local record from Chrome storage.
no.summary.saved: No summary has been saved for this meeting yet.
summary.later.title: Summary still open
summary.later.description: The transcript is saved. Generate the summary now, or come back from History later.
summary.detail.description: Use this as the polished meeting readout.
structured.notes.description: Actionable items extracted from the summary.
no.transcript.saved: No transcript has been saved for this meeting yet.
transcript.detail.description: Original transcript text for verification and follow-up.
no.summary.saved.yet: No summary has been created for this meeting yet.
click.to.edit.title: Click to edit
confirm.delete: Are you sure you want to delete this meeting? This cannot be undone.
confirm.discard.recording.draft: Discard this untranscribed recording? The local audio draft will be deleted.
unknown.error: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
microphone.not.available: Microphone access is not available in this extension context.
microphone.access.blocked: Microphone access was blocked. Allow microphone access for this extension in Chrome, then start the recording again.
could.not.save.draft: The recording could not be saved as a draft:
could.not.copy.summary: The summary could not be copied:
live.transcript.description: The transcript appears in real-time while recording.
